scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:web
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:runtime && pnpm run build:vscode && pnpm run build:jetbrains
scripts.test: pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:jetbrains
scripts.test:neovim: cd hosts/neovim && nvim --headless -u NONE -c "lua package.path='./lua/?.lua;./lua/?/init.lua;'..package.path; assert(require('oxp')); assert(require('oxp.permissions')); assert(require('oxp.capabilities')); print('ok')" -c qa
scripts.test:conformance: pnpm run build:runtime && pnpm run build:hello-rust && bash scripts/cross-host-conformance.sh
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:neovim && pnpm run test:conformance
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist .next .turbo tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && cargo clean --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml && cargo clean --manifest-path examples/hello-rust/Cargo.toml
scripts.release: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' publish --access public --no-git-checks
